title: GHA Simulator — Technical Sample
description: Synthetic prompts for validating the simulator. This is not an official or representative Google assessment.

questions.text: I can begin a low-risk task when some details are still being clarified.
I prefer to pause every task until all possible details are known.
I check important work before sharing it.
I communicate early when a commitment may change.

statements.text: I organize the next steps before beginning.
I ask for input when it improves the result.
I adapt the plan when new information appears.
I keep concise notes about key decisions.
I verify ownership before handing work over.
I raise a risk while there is still time to respond.
I prefer a clear checklist for repeated work.
I enjoy finding a simpler way to complete a task.
I make room for colleagues to explain their view.
I close small gaps before they become larger issues.
I focus first on the outcome with the highest impact.
I summarize decisions so others can act on them.

questions.scenario: A test file contains an obvious formatting error shortly before an internal demonstration.

actions.text: Correct it and record the change.
Leave it unchanged without telling anyone.

questions.scenario: Two teammates interpret a synthetic project instruction differently.

actions.text: Compare the interpretations against the stated goal.
Ask the owner to clarify the material difference.

questions.scenario: A routine task produces an unexpected result in this technical sample.

actions.text: Check the inputs and reproduce the result.
Assume the result is correct because the task is routine.
Delete the result and do not investigate.

questions.scenario: A sample deadline changes after work has started.

actions.text: Recheck priorities and communicate the updated plan.
Continue with the old plan without mentioning the change.
Identify which scope can move while preserving quality.
